name: Kenban Piano School
description: A quiet, typographic education theme for a small piano school in a wooden house. Paper white, ivory and ebony, with one muted brass accent used only for large type and small marks (the raised key's baseline, today's timetable bar, the free-first-lesson dot and the five staff lines before each label). The header is a row of ruled cells read like a keyboard: the wordmark in the first cell, each menu item a white key with short ebony black keys between them, the current page a raised paper-white key. The home page is oversized type only: one tempo marking, Andante, set very large on five faint staff lines with a short gloss and the term at a glance beneath, then the five lessons and fees as ruled rows, five tempo words from Largo to Allegro that tell how a pupil moves through the school, the next recital date in tall numerals, the journal as text rows and the free first lesson. The footer is the weekly lesson timetable on ebony, with today marked from the site's timezone, beside the school details. With Lessons, Teachers, Recitals, The school, Journal, Newsletter and Contact (a first-lesson enquiry that composes an email, no backend). The school details, the term, the lesson fees and the timetable are synced patterns, edited once. Linden Hill over Atkinson Hyperlegible. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H6 / F11 / L9 as planned). Added colours: deep brass #6E5A30 for links and small labels (6.4:1 on paper, 5.6:1 on ivory), felt grey #5C5954 for secondary text (6.7:1 / 5.9:1), pale brass #B8A47A for labels on the ebony footer (7.4:1), mist #A9A59D for secondary text on ebony (7.4:1, CSS only) and hairline #D8D4CC for rules only. The planned muted brass #9A8152 (3.6:1 paper, 3.1:1 ivory, 4.9:1 ebony) is used only for large type and marks (staff lines, the raised key's baseline, today's bar, the first-lesson dot, the recital date's point). Ebony text 17.5:1 on paper, 15.2:1 on ivory.
